read.thesis: Cognizant grew 4.1% cc on $5.5B revenue with 16.0% adjusted margin, but cut FY revenue growth to 4%–5.5% as discretionary spend stayed weak; supply-side signals are headcount flat and no capex, so the read is soft demand with AI-led pricing shift.

triggers.label: FY revenue growth cut to 4%–5.5%
triggers.quote: We have therefore revised our full-year revenue guidance range to 4% to 5.5% growth in constant currency.

triggers.label: TTM bookings +5%, book-to-bill 1.3
triggers.quote: On a trailing 12-month basis, bookings grew 5% and represented a book-to-bill of 1.3.

triggers.label: Financial services up 12% cc
triggers.quote: Financial services grew nearly 12% year-over-year in constant currency, the second consecutive quarter of 10%-plus growth.

guidance.quote: We have therefore revised our full-year revenue guidance range to 4% to 5.5% growth in constant currency.
Our EPS guidance has increased to $5.70 to $5.82 representing 8% to 10% growth versus 7% to 9% growth previously.
Our adjusted operating margin guidance is unchanged at 16% to 16.2%
For the third quarter, we expect revenue to grow 3.8% to 5.3% year-over-year in constant currency.
Our free cash flow conversion guidance for the year remains 90% to 100% of net income.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Instead, macro uncertainty has remained elevated.
Excluding these impacts, second quarter adjusted operating margin was 16%.

red_flags.label: Discretionary spend weak; guidance cut
red_flags.quote: Instead, macro uncertainty has remained elevated.

red_flags.label: DSO up 5 days to 88
red_flags.quote: DSO was 88 days, up five days year-over-year primarily driven by a change in the business mix.

red_flags.label: One in four Global 2000 paused AI deployments
red_flags.quote: one in four have paused AI deployments
